summary: Identity legibility and the raw-value humanization fixes hold cleanly on this seventh community with its distinctive named-individual persona model. The judge's most important finding -- Messages tab shows zero conversations for a messaging-purpose community, flagged critical-blocker -- was investigated and root-caused precisely, not just accepted at face value: the fixture seeds 3 real message threads with participantAPersonaId literally 'platform-member-alex', matching the exact persona label ('Alex Rivera') this walkthrough signed up as, so the threads SHOULD be visible under the visibility.readGuard formula ($viewer == participantAPersonaId). They are not, because LocalAuthApi.signUp (part30_local_auth_api.dart:157) generates accountId as '$personaTypeId-$counter' (e.g. 'platform-member-alex-1') for every fresh signup -- a numeric-suffixed ID that never equals the seed data's bare 'platform-member-alex' string. This is a real, systemic identity-matching gap between how seeded demo data authors participant IDs and how live accounts are actually identified, not previously exercised because most other communities' guards use allowedPersonaIds against personaTypeId rather than formula guards against literal seeded instance-data strings. Deliberately NOT fixed live in this session given the blast radius (changes either $actor/$viewer resolution semantics or seed-data authoring convention) -- recommended as a dedicated future CJM ticket. Other findings (sponsor card empty body, ad-telemetry leak to Member persona, Admin tab empty for Member persona, internal-jargon copy, FAB occlusion, chip duplication) are UX polish, deferred.

rootCausedFinding.title: Fresh signup's accountId never matches seed data's bare persona-type participant IDs
rootCausedFinding.confirmedRootCause: part30_local_auth_api.dart:157 -- accountId: '$personaTypeId-$counter' -- produces e.g. 'platform-member-alex-1' for a fresh signup, but the fixture's 3 seeded platform-message-thread instances hardcode participantAPersonaId/participantBPersonaId as bare persona-type strings ('platform-member-alex', 'platform-member-bailey', 'platform-member-casey') with no counter suffix. The visibility.readGuard formula '$viewer == participantAPersonaId || $viewer == participantBPersonaId' therefore never matches for any freshly-signed-up account, only for however the demo data's seeded personas were originally identified (if ever live-tested at all).
rootCausedFinding.whyNotFixedThisPass: Blast radius is real: the fix is either a change to how $actor/$viewer resolve (accountId vs personaTypeId) affecting every formula guard in every community, or a change to how seed data should author participant references -- neither is a quick, isolated fix like the labelTemplate additions made elsewhere this session. Recommended as its own dedicated CJM ticket with a Root Cause Agent dispatch to determine the correct fix shape before implementing.
